decision: Delivery surface supersedes communication channel as the canonical adapter capability name. The DEV contract, runtime configuration, package paths, and JSONL implementation use delivery-surface terminology without a parallel compatibility vocabulary.
implemented_capabilities: core delivery adapters implement DeliverySurfaceAdapter with the delivery-surface capability kind
runtime configuration composes delivery_surfaces as independent destinations
bundled adapter and package paths live under adapters/delivery-surfaces
architectural_invariants: approval surfaces and delivery surfaces remain independent capabilities
DeliveryEnvelope and DeliveryReceipt remain the vendor-neutral core boundary
the jsonl-outbox adapter identity and persisted delivery idempotency identity remain stable
the pre-release rename does not create a second compatibility architecture or advance product maturity
